view_skim_note: skim — headings, bold text, first lines
view_glance20_note: glance — about 1 word in 5, top to bottom
tabs_note: The letter · highlighted: the parts to read
fix_none_wrong: No busy reader got it wrong.
missed_no_wrong: Some details were missed, but no wrong answers.
nothing_detail: It asks the reader to do nothing and gives no date, warning or contact, so busy readers have nothing to get wrong.
nothing_to_do: Nothing you need to do right now.
highlights: The highlighted parts of the letter say this.
mistakes_title: Mistakes people make when they skim this
skim_think: If you only skim, you might think
key_sub: Readers are marked against this. Fix anything wrong.
fix_pitch: Tries a dozen small changes. Keeps your words.
points_wrong: {words} now points the wrong way. Write the date out.
kind_newsletter_note: This reads like a newsletter with many topics. Misread works best on a letter about one thing, so treat these scores as rough.
kind_template_note: This looks like a blank template. Fill in the blanks with sample values first.
kind_not_a_letter_note: This doesn't read like a letter. It's more like a guide, slides or a report, so the scores may not mean much.
note_template: This looks like a template: {n} blanks like {eg}. Fill them in with sample values first, or readers have nothing real to read.
note_letters: This file holds {n} letters. Test one at a time.
ck_action_ok_title: What to do is on the first phone screen
ck_action_no_title: What to do is below the first phone screen
ck_deadline_ok_title: The deadline is on the first phone screen
ck_deadline_no_title: The deadline is below the first phone screen
ck_phone_ok_detail: It starts at word {pos}, so phone readers see it.
ck_phone_no_detail: It starts at word {pos} of {total}. On a phone people see about the first {limit} words, so put it at the top.
ck_bold_no_title: {n} of {total} key sentences are plain text
ck_bold_detail: Skimmers read headings and bold text first. Make the sentences readers must act on bold, or gather them in a short “What you need to do” box at the top.
ck_rep_no_detail: The same sentences appear more than once. Cut the repeats: readers skip what looks familiar, and the important parts get buried.
ck_len_no_detail: Most people read only about a fifth of a long page. Aim for under {limit} words, or put what the reader must do at the very top.
repeated_block: Repeated · this part already appears above
note_scrambled: This file's text looks garbled: its font hides the real letters, so names, dates and amounts may be misread. Check the answer key carefully against the printed letter, or paste the text from the original document (for example the Word file or web page).
note_blank_readers: Most careful readers couldn't make sense of this letter, so treat these scores with care. The AI readers read some languages (such as Tamil) and some table layouts poorly.
